title: Customer approval link for settlement sign-off (spec section 9.2; trigger met: 211 cases settled manually)
acceptance_criteria: A planner sends a customer a single-case link; the customer sees only that case's settlement summary and approves or rejects with a comment
The link is a signed, expiring, single-case token; it opens nothing else and is revocable
Approval is recorded as a case event with who, when and the version approved
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
